_readme: Your analyst inputs: the things no public API can tell you. Everything here is optional.
Company-level keys: area, note, sponsor, partners, patentYrs, diff (0-1), mkt (0-1), own (% institutional), emp, price, catalysts, financings, programs.
sponsor: the lead-sponsor name used on ClinicalTrials.gov, if it differs from the SEC company name.
catalysts: dated events you know from press releases, e.g. {"date": "2027-02-14", "kind": "regulatory", "label": "PDUFA date"}. kind is one of readout, regulatory, earnings, financing, conference.
financings: replaces the auto-detected SEC offering list, e.g. {"date": "2026-03-05", "type": "Follow-on offering", "amt": 85, "dil": 19.4}. Use type "ATM program" to trigger the ATM alert.

programs: keyed by the drug name as it appears on ClinicalTrials.gov. Keys: name, aliases, tgt, moa, ph (override, e.g. Filed or Approved), ind, ep, ro (readout date guided by the company), peak, launch (years to launch), cost (remaining development cost). All dollar figures in millions USD.
Programs without a peak sales figure get a placeholder by phase, and the app labels it as a placeholder.
